digest.component_or_area: bug-trend prevention program and epic completion verification
propositions: Bug provenance must be observable at creation with detected-by metadata and queryable via bug_trends metrics without requiring new user input

Deterministic pre-LLM gates must prevent raw git writes bypassing the store seam, unread config schema fields, unchecked wall-clock asserts in tests, incomplete AC checkboxes at close, dead code comments, and oversized bug-fix diffs lacking plan-review attestation
Production shell logic including reconcile-bridge, canary workflows, probe harness, and vote normalizer must be migrated from shell to Python following the strangler-fig pattern
Canary and automation bug filing must follow a hardened dedup pattern with a documented bug-creation contract and deterministic dedup-key normalization
Engine-layer validation placement must be enforced as advisory guidance at plan review, and oversized bug fixes must be blocked by Gerrit backstop without valid review-plan

Code comments citing dead SHAs, run-ids, or dates must be remediated to ticket citations with CI guards preventing regression, and pre-normalization attestations must be grandfathered during validity recomputation
